title: MingCute Screenshot Quality Recovery batch 023
review_goal: Differentiate five MingCute contacts and group variants with screenshot grounded depicts and deterministic evidence fields.

items.depicts_observation: Person bust outline with three short contact lines stacked at the right
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants a person profile icon paired with short contact lines.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for notebook or calendar contact variants when the bust and side lines matter.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot shows a person bust on the left with three short lines aligned to the right.

items.depicts_observation: Calendar style contact card with top rings and a face inside the panel
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants contacts shown as a page with binder rings and a face.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for bust or book contact icons when the top binder rings are visible.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot looks like a ring bound contact page rather than a standalone person bust.

items.depicts_observation: Closed address book outline with a face on the cover and a side spine
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants contacts represented as a book or binder rather than a loose card.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for page or bust variants when the side spine and cover panel matter.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot shows a book like cover with a visible side spine behind the front panel.

items.depicts_observation: Person bust outline with a wide oval body and three side contact lines
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants the contact bust variant with a wider oval body base.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for the simpler bust when the wide oval body and side lines are the visible cue.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot differs from contacts by using a broader oval body beneath the round head.

items.depicts_observation: Two person bust outlines with one smaller figure offset behind the right side
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants a group icon with one large bust and one smaller companion figure.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for three person or oval body groups when the side companion figure is the cue.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot shows a large left bust with a smaller second figure tucked behind the right side.
